description:
Confirm or refute the exploratory lead of the scalar lane over the selected SIMD lane of `BitMatrix::matvec` at mid-range strides, and set the SIMD threshold from confirmatory evidence.

## Background

The dense-parity baseline campaigns under `dev/bench_results/2037941f/` include allocated whole-`matvec` cells that compare the scalar-reference build with the build that selects the fused AND-popcount SIMD lane. Their exploratory rows record the SIMD lane as `regressed` against the scalar reference at the 8-, 9- and 63-word strides, `inconclusive` at 65 words and `not-worse` at 64 words, at the pilot pair count; the generated mid-range tables under `dev/active/2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/` carry each row with its interval. The selector admits the SIMD lane from `MATVEC_SIMD_MIN_WORDS` upward, which the measured strides all satisfy. Exploratory rows cannot select a production route, and no confirmatory campaign has asked this question.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A frozen addendum under the shared measurement protocol declares confirmatory allocated whole-`matvec` cells at the strides whose exploratory rows favour the scalar lane and at their neighbours, with margins and a resolution rule fixed before any confirmatory trial.
- [hard] REQ-02: The confirmation receipt reports each cell's sample count, corrected confidence interval and outcome, and every losing, inconclusive or unavailable cell stays committed as recorded.
- [hard] REQ-03: The threshold changes only for strides where the confirmation records a whole-consumer benefit beyond the frozen worthwhile-effect margin, the changed selection has before/after cells on the exact declared domain and its neighbours, and it stays unchanged otherwise with the outcome recorded.
- [hard] REQ-04: Shared scalar and SIMD suites prove exact outputs at the 0, 1, 63, 64 and 65 boundaries on both sides of any changed threshold, and Rust 1.95 builds the path.
- [hard] REQ-05: The outcome reaches the canonical offline tuning system as the single source of the threshold; no private constant duplicates it.

## Notes

Found by the mid-range evidence synthesis. Timed work runs only in the benchmark window on the prepared host.
title: Calibrate the BitMatrix::matvec SIMD threshold against the scalar lane
